items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So it was that kind of relationship that we had but that was all out of that… Eddie Cole‟s was a giant. Dexter Travis was… well he couldn‟t even get into our society [laughter].

ctx.x: Yeah, he could do it, even when he was older.
Yeah. Now the guy that really was a big man was Dexter Travis‟ father.
